body.statement: For a causal MPDAG \(G\) and disjoint node sets \(X,Y\), the procedure in Theorem 3 of Guo and Perkovic returns finitely many MPDAGs whose represented-DAG sets partition \([G]\), within each of which the total effect of \(X\) on \(Y\) is identified; for any two distinct output MPDAGs, some observational density consistent with \(G\) makes their identified effects different.

source.verbatim_statement: Suppose G is a causal MPDAG and A,Y are two disjoint node sets in G. Let L={G_1,...,G_n} be the output of IDGraphs(A,Y,G). Then: (i) the total effect of A on Y is identified in each G_i; (ii) for any i not equal to j, there exists an observational density consistent with G such that the effects identified from that density in G_i and G_j are different; and (iii) L is a partition of G in terms of DAGs represented.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the authors' PMLR 130 proceedings PDF, Theorem 3, page 5 (PDF page 4).
